    Inspection scope
    Paint, place, undo, save named designs, and playtest validated maps. Browser saves use a separate 3D editor database. Reusable blocks remain available for inspection; use the existing editor for block assembly and generation.
    Floors, scenery and character models are derived from the blueprint. Hidden roofs and boundaries do not intercept inspection.
